tagline.zh: success / info / warning / danger 四态,每态一套「底 / 边 / 字」三件套:同色相派生,文字过 AA 4.5:1、边框过非文本 3:1,demo 逐态实时复核。
tagline.en: Four states — success / info / warning / danger — each with a bg/border/text triple derived from one hue: text gates at AA 4.5:1, borders at the 3:1 non-text gate, audited live per state.

origin.zh: 结构配方来自 Radix 12 步语义色阶:底(步 1–3)、边(步 6–8)、字(步 11–12)各自独立档位,文本步以 APCA Lc60/90 定标(Radix 官方文档,调研 06§8);四态色相锚点取 Evil Martians oklch 色相映射:红≈20°、黄≈90°、绿≈140°、蓝≈220°(调研 06§2);container+on 配对同构 M3 的 error / error-container 角色与 error 基线 #B3261E(调研 06§7);阈值取 WCAG 2.1(调研 06§17)。
origin.en: The structural recipe comes from the Radix 12-step scale: backgrounds (steps 1–3), borders (6–8) and text (11–12) live on separate steps, with text steps targeted at APCA Lc60/90 (official Radix docs, research 06 §8); the four hue anchors take Evil Martians' oklch hue map: red≈20°, yellow≈90°, green≈140°, blue≈220° (research 06 §2); the container+on pairing mirrors M3's error / error-container roles and the #B3261E error baseline (research 06 §7); thresholds are WCAG 2.1 (research 06 §17).

effect.zh: success 态色相。默认 140° = oklch 刻度的绿区锚点(Evil Martians:绿≈140°,调研 06§2)。
effect.en: Success hue. Default 140° = the green anchor on the oklch wheel (Evil Martians: green≈140°, research 06 §2).

effect.zh: info 态色相。默认 220° = oklch 刻度的蓝区锚点(Evil Martians:蓝≈220°,调研 06§2)。
effect.en: Info hue. Default 220° = the blue anchor on the oklch wheel (Evil Martians: blue≈220°, research 06 §2).

effect.zh: warning 态色相。默认 90° = oklch 刻度的黄区锚点(Evil Martians:黄≈90°,调研 06§2);黄区字色天然偏深(需要更低的 L 才够对比),demo 的 L 常量按黄区一并标定。
effect.en: Warning hue. Default 90° = the yellow anchor on the oklch wheel (Evil Martians: yellow≈90°, research 06 §2); yellow text runs naturally dark (it needs a lower L to hold contrast), and the demo's L constants are calibrated across the yellow region too.

effect.zh: danger 态色相。默认 20° = oklch 刻度的红区锚点(Evil Martians:红≈20°,调研 06§2);官方锚点是 M3 error 基线 #B3261E(调研 06§7,本会话实测配白字 6.54:1)。
effect.en: Danger hue. Default 20° = the red anchor on the oklch wheel (Evil Martians: red≈20°, research 06 §2); the official anchor is the M3 error baseline #B3261E (research 06 §7, measured this session at 6.54:1 with white text).

effect.zh: 状态文字色的 oklch L(四态共用,C 固定 0.13)。默认 0.45 是本会话标定值:四态文字在 L=0.97/C=0.04 的淡底上实测 6.17–6.97:1,全部过正文 AA;调高(变浅)会向 4.5:1 逼近甚至跌破——面板实时复核。
effect.en: The oklch L of status text (shared by all four states, C fixed at 0.13). Default 0.45 is this session's calibration: the four text colors on the L=0.97/C=0.04 tinted backgrounds measure 6.17–6.97:1, all passing body AA; raising it (lighter text) approaches or breaks 4.5:1 — audited live in the panel.

note.zh: demo 的底/边/字三件套用 oklch() 渲染:Baseline 2023-05(MDN,调研 06§1);对比度复核为 JS 内联 WCAG 公式,与浏览器支持无关。老浏览器需要为每态准备 hex 兜底(由同一换算生成)。
note.en: The bg/border/text triples render with oklch(): Baseline since 2023-05 (MDN, research 06 §1); the contrast audit is inline WCAG math, independent of browser support. Legacy browsers need per-state hex fallbacks (generated by the same conversion).

fallback.zh: oklch() 声明在老浏览器整条失效:先写 hex 兜底(同一换算矩阵生成),再用 @supports (color: oklch(0.7 0.1 200)) 覆写;color-mix(in srgb, …, transparent) 的淡底可用 rgba 等价兜底。
fallback.en: oklch() declarations drop entirely on legacy browsers: ship hex fallbacks first (generated by the same conversion matrices), then override under @supports (color: oklch(0.7 0.1 200)); the color-mix(in srgb, …, transparent) tints fall back to equivalent rgba values.

use.zh: 告警条/提示条/toast 的四态皮肤:每态只发三个变量(--st-bg/--st-border/--st-fg),组件零改码
use.en: Theming alerts, callouts and toasts in four states: each state ships three variables (--st-bg/--st-border/--st-fg) with zero component changes

use.zh: 表单校验与 CI/管道状态:红绿之外仍要过色盲复核——明度差承载状态信息,色相只是冗余编码(Primer 色盲主题同思路,调研 06§19)
use.en: Form validation and CI/pipeline statuses: beyond red/green, pass the colorblind check — lightness carries the state, hue stays redundant coding (Primer's colorblind themes, research 06 §19)

use.zh: 品牌换肤后重建状态色:四态从各自色相重新派生并整组重跑 AA(管线化,不逐个手调)
use.en: Rebuilding status colors after a re-brand: derive the four states from their hues and re-run AA as a group (a pipeline, not per-case hand tuning)

use.zh: 徽标/角标的实底变体:同色相取更高色度档做底、低档做字,继续复用同一组阈值复核
use.en: Solid badge variants: a higher-chroma step as fill and a lower one as text on the same hue, re-audited against the same thresholds

avoid.zh: 只靠红/绿区分成败——红绿色盲用户读不到;状态必须另带图标/文字(色盲复核,调研 06§19)
avoid.en: Relying on red/green alone for pass/fail — colorblind users lose the signal; states need icons or text as well (colorblind review, research 06 §19)

avoid.zh: 淡底上的浅色文字:底越浓、字越浅越容易跌破 4.5:1(WCAG 判定不四舍五入,4.499:1 不达标,调研 06§17)
avoid.en: Pale text on saturated tints: the stronger the tint and lighter the text, the easier 4.5:1 breaks (WCAG judges unrounded — 4.499:1 fails, research 06 §17)

avoid.zh: 边框颜色只当装饰不看 3:1——表达状态语义的边框属于 SC 1.4.11 非文本对比度范围(调研 06§17)
avoid.en: Treating the border as pure decoration — a border that carries state semantics falls under SC 1.4.11 non-text contrast (research 06 §17)

avoid.zh: 四态各自手挑 hex 而无派生规则——换一次主题就要全部重调,且档位间关系失去可预测性(Radix 步进结构的反面,调研 06§8)
avoid.en: Hand-picking hex per state with no derivation rule — every re-theme starts from scratch and the steps lose predictability (the inverse of Radix's step structure, research 06 §8)

a11y.zh: 两道闸(WCAG 2.1,调研 06§17):文字对底 ≥4.5:1(正文 AA,AAA≥7:1),大字(≥18pt 或 ≥14pt bold)减半;传达状态的边框/图标对底 ≥3:1(SC 1.4.11 非文本,仅默认状态要求,禁用组件豁免)。判定用未舍入原值。本会话标定(默认四色相,底 L=0.97/C=0.04、字 L=0.45/C=0.13、边 L=0.6/C=0.17):文字 6.17–6.97:1、边框 3.20–3.76:1,四态全过。工业参照:Radix 步 11/12 在步 2 背景上保 APCA Lc60/90(调研 06§8);红绿轴信息另需色盲复核(Okabe-Ito 思路/Primer 色盲主题,调研 06§19)。
a11y.en: Two gates (WCAG 2.1, research 06 §17): text on its background ≥4.5:1 (body AA; AAA≥7:1), large text (≥18pt or ≥14pt bold) halved; state-bearing borders/icons ≥3:1 against adjacent colors (SC 1.4.11 non-text, default state only, disabled components exempt). Verdicts unrounded. This session's calibration (default hues; bg L=0.97/C=0.04, text L=0.45/C=0.13, border L=0.6/C=0.17): text 6.17–6.97:1, borders 3.20–3.76:1 — all four states pass. Industrial reference: Radix steps 11/12 hold APCA Lc60/90 on step-2 backgrounds (research 06 §8); red/green signals additionally need a colorblind review (Okabe-Ito thinking / Primer colorblind themes, research 06 §19).

goal.zh: 实现 success/info/warning/danger 四态提示组件:每态一套底/边/字三件套(同色相派生),文字过 AA 4.5:1、状态边框过 3:1,另配图标/文字承载语义(不单靠颜色),并输出逐态对比度表。
goal.en: Build success/info/warning/danger callout states: one bg/border/text triple per state derived from a single hue, text gating at AA 4.5:1 and state borders at 3:1, semantics carried by icon/text as well as color, with a per-state contrast table.

acceptance.zh: 四态结构同构:每态恰好 bg/border/text 三个 token,全部从该态色相派生
acceptance.en: The four states are isomorphic: exactly three tokens each (bg/border/text), all derived from that state's hue

acceptance.zh: 文字/底 ≥4.5:1、状态边框/底 ≥3:1,判定用未舍入原值
acceptance.en: Text/bg ≥4.5:1 and state border/bg ≥3:1, judged unrounded

acceptance.zh: 状态语义同时由图标或文字承载,不以颜色为唯一通道
acceptance.en: State semantics also ride an icon or text — color is never the only channel

acceptance.zh: 红绿两态通过色盲复核(明度差/图标冗余),参考 Primer 色盲主题思路
acceptance.en: Red and green pass a colorblind review (lightness difference / icon redundancy), following Primer's colorblind-theme thinking

acceptance.zh: 组件只消费三个语义变量,换态只换变量不换组件代码
acceptance.en: Components consume only the three semantic variables; switching states swaps variables, never component code
